title: The Mapster WP Maps WordPress plugin before 2.0.6 does not perform any authorization check on a REST API route that…
description: The Mapster WP Maps WordPress plugin versions prior to 2.0.6 contain a vulnerability where a REST API route that modifies post data lacks authorization checks. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite post titles, create new published posts, and alter the plugin's stored settings.
